basic_info.description: Spectacular patio home featuring soaring 16-foot ceilings and a uniquely flexible layout. The oversized private outdoor area is ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or soaking up the sun. This home offers a modern chef's kitchen, gas fireplace, and massive west-facing windows with motorized shades. Bonus perks include a newer full-size washer/dryer, TWO-car parking with EV charger option, and top-tier building amenities like secure entry, elevator, rooftop deck, and lightning-fast Webpass internet.  Tucked quietly at the rear of the building, this spacious loft home is just steps from the Mission's best restaurants, BART, and tech shuttles.  Welcome to the New Mission District!
